A charged metal sphere is insulated from its surroundings. It is not connected to a battery or
power supply. A flying lead is used to connect the sphere to earth through an ammeter.

What happens to the pointer on the ammeter when the lead is connected to the sphere?
A
It does not move.
B
It deflects and then returns to zero.
C
It deflects and gives a steady reading.
D
It deflects to give a positive reading and then a negative reading.
